15.4 Client Brain Creation Trigger

A Client Brain is instantiated when ANY ONE of these occurs:

Pilot purchased

Retainer signed

Long-term contract approved

No brain for:

Cold leads

Discovery calls

Website visitors

15.5 Required Client Brain Files (MANDATORY)

Each client brain must contain exactly these files:

client_profile.md
client_offer.md
client_kpis.md
client_assets.md
client_history.md
client_constraints.md


No file → no deployment.
